summary: SPDT reflective UltraCMOS RF switch, 10-3000 MHz, typ. input P1dB +33.5 dBm at 2.3-3.3 V (ample for SX1262 +22 dBm), 1.8-3.3 V, SC-70-6. The switch in SX1262 datasheet Figure 14-2 and in Semtech's SX1262MB2CAS 915 MHz reference BOM (U2). Wired for single-pin control mode, as the Semtech reference does it: pin 6 is the switch supply (through R4 100R / C14 1nF from +3V3, where the reference feeds it from the host's ANT_SW line) and CTRL is driven through an R3 100R / C15 1nF filter from node:ctrl (the reference drives it from SX1262 DIO2). CTRL high = RFC to RF1 (TX in the reference), CTRL low = RFC to RF2 (RX). Every RF pin must be DC blocked: RFC's 39 pF block (reference C8) is here, so the common port is node:rfc; RF1/RF2 rely on the radio side's series caps (SX1262 reference C6 on the TX path, C11 on the RX path). LCSC listed stock was 0 at curation time; pin-compatible clones (TECH PUBLIC TPE4259-63 C47117600, Tokmas, XINLUDA) are stocked but are not this datasheet

cite.reading: The DC block itself is required by p.3 ("All RF pins must be DC blocked with an external series capacitor or held at 0 VDC."); the PE4259 datasheet gives no value. 39pF is C8 (GJM1555C1H390JB01D, C0G) on U2 RFC in Semtech's SX1262MB2CAS 915 MHz reference (SX1262MB2CAS_915MHz_e499v01b_BOM.xlsx, row "C8 | GJM1555C1H390JB01D | 0402 | 39pF"; topology on SX1262MB2xAS_e499v01b_sch_layout.pdf p.1). See catalog/staging-sx1262/frontend-sources.md

Single-pin control mode needs a ~3 V supply on pin 6 (p.4: "requires a dedicated +3-volt power supply connection on pin 6 (VDD)"). The 100R feed is R4 (CRCW0402100RFKED) from ANT_SW to U2 pin 6 in Semtech's SX1262MB2CAS reference (BOM row "R4 | CRCW0402100RFKED | 0402 | 100R"; schematic p.1 draws ANT_SW - R4 100R - pin 6 CTRL-bar). Here fed from +3V3 instead of a host GPIO; confirm

C14 1nF (GRM155R72A102KA01D) from U2 pin 6 to GND in Semtech's SX1262MB2CAS reference (BOM row "C14 | GRM155R72A102KA01D | 0402 | 1nF"; value also printed on schematic p.1). The PE4259 datasheet states no bypass for single-pin mode

R3 100R (CRCW0402100RFKED) in series from SX1262 DIO2 to U2 pin 4 CTRL in Semtech's SX1262MB2CAS reference (BOM row "R3 | CRCW0402100RFKED | 0402 | 100R"; schematic p.1). Not stated in the PE4259 datasheet

C15 1nF (GRM155R72A102KA01D) from U2 pin 4 CTRL to GND in Semtech's SX1262MB2CAS reference (BOM row "C15 | GRM155R72A102KA01D | 0402 | 1nF"; value also printed on schematic p.1). Not stated in the PE4259 datasheet
